svg.title: VietLegal SearchOps — proposed system workflow
svg.desc: Six architecture panels connect official-source ingestion, versioned corpus and legal chunks, source-group data splits and E5 training, exact-input embedding reuse and immutable snapshot publication, pinned hybrid retrieval and Qwen answers, and saved-output evaluation with a human-calibrated DeepSeek Judge. Gold is isolated from retrieval and generation. Assumptions A1 to A5 identify open design choices. This is a proposal with no measured results.
svg.text: From official sources to cited answers
A proposed architecture for Vietnamese labour-contract search, reproducible model training and evidence-based evaluation.

g.text: Build offline artifacts, serve one pinned snapshot, then score saved outputs.
Calibration and test stay held out
Open the cited revision + source span
Retain historical text and raw files
Held-out labels and source evidence sets
Read 01–05 for module boundaries, persistent artifacts, API contracts and release checks.
Keep provenance and legal structure stable before creating supervision or indexes.
Document ≠ revision ≠ source unit ≠ chunk occurrence. Shared vectors never erase occurrence provenance.
Outputs: C1 → source-group data construction in 02; C2 → the snapshot builder in 03. OCR remains an optional extension.
Split source groups before authoring; tune on train, select on dev, freeze before test.
C1 may include source text from all splits. Held-out groups never supply training positives or mined target evidence.
Dependency: H01 corpus → H02 pilot data + H03 evaluator → H04 train release → E1. D0 search enables integration before E1 is ready.
A new snapshot is prepared in isolation. Incomplete or failed builds never become active.
Recovery is part of the update contract
Failure → keep the active pointer unchanged. Resume the same job ID from verified cache entries and its journal.
Check idempotency, no-edit, metadata-only, changed breadcrumbs, shared-vector deletion and concurrent switching.
A new checkpoint creates a new embedding profile: old-profile hits are invalid.
Measure full / document / exact-reuse baselines with matched cache scope and target.
A2: bundle file layout is proposed. A5: full-rebuild parity gates release audits; production audit frequency and history retention remain open.
FastAPI, CLI and the evaluator call the same retrieval core. Provider weights stay fixed.
REQUEST SCOPE / S1 IS PINNED THROUGH GENERATION AND SOURCE RESOLUTION
Dev defaults, not results: top-100 per branch; RRF c=60; top-10 API; context ≈2,048 E5 tokens. Check Qwen input limits separately.
Predict first. Read gold only for scoring. Keep deterministic and semantic judgments distinct.
LICH / EVALUATION + JUDGE DAT + LICH / HUMAN LABELS
SYSTEM CALLS / GOLD IS EXCLUDED FROM THIS BOUNDARY
Gold cannot choose retrieved passages or Qwen context. Judge groundedness uses exactly the context Qwen received.
Test is frozen. Calibration changes only J1; later provider / rubric / gold changes create a new evaluation profile or benchmark version.
Blue borders mark focal modules or artifacts. Dashed scope outlines show isolation boundaries.
[A1] Module paths and the /source route are proposed. PL-03–PL-06 must freeze schemas and API details.
[A2] Proposed bundle names and file layout. Publication switches a service reference, not a cross-file SQLite transaction.
[A3] Exact vector backend is open: NumPy or FAISS Flat. [A4] Provider/model identities must be verified and pinned per run.
[A5] Release audits require full-rebuild parity. Production audit cadence and historical-snapshot retention remain open.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: propose.md · docs/PHAN_CONG_CONG_VIEC.md · vietlegal_paper/sections/01–12 + appendices
